Their head coach was [[Matt Painter]], in his 13th season with the Boilers. The team played their home games in [[Mackey Arena]] in [[West Lafayette, Indiana]] as members of the [[Big Ten Conference]]. The Boilermakers finished the season 30–7, 15–3 in [[2017–18 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten play]] to finish in a tie for second place. As the No. 3 seed in the [[2017-18 Big Ten Conference men's basketball season|Big Ten tournament]], they defeated [[2017–18 Rutgers Scarlet Knights men's basketball team|Rutgers]]{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401020039|title=Rutgers vs. Purdue - In the [[2017 Big Ten Conference men's basketball tournament|Big Ten tournament]], they lost in the finals to [[2016–17 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 4 seed in the Midwest Region where they beat [[2016–17 Vermont Catamounts men's basketball team|Vermont]] and [[2016–17 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Iowa State]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen.
